text: 1. Non-Chinese nationals;22. Friendly towards China, with no criminal record, and abiding by the laws, regulations and school rules of the Chinese government; 3. Physically and mentally healthy, with excellent academic performance; 4. Willing to engage in Chinese language education, teaching and related work; 5. Age range is 18-35 years old (calculated uniformly as September 1, 2025). For in-service Chinese language teachers, the age limit is relaxed to 45 years old; 6. A recommendation institution is required at the time of application.
